title: The Checker Checked Itself
headline: THE CHECKER CHECKED ITSELF
synopsis: Kit builds a fact-checker for PR descriptions. Its first case is its own PR, and it objects four times.
altText: Panel 1: Kit the fox proudly shows off a small magnifying-glass robot that checks PR descriptions. Panel 2: the robot stamps Kit's own PR again and again under a sign reading CONTRADICTED x4 while Kit sweats. Panel 3: Kit adjusts gears in the robot's back; the sign now reads 0 CONTRADICTED.
layout: three wide panels left to right; the stamps in panel 2 spill over the panel border

panels.scene: A tidy workshop. Kit the fox proudly presents a small round robot with a magnifying glass for a face, standing on a desk beside a printed pull request

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Meet the claim checker. It catches made-up PR claims!

panels.scene: The robot reads the printed pull request through its magnifying glass and slams a big rubber stamp on it again and again; Kit sweats nervously
Kit, sleeves rolled up, adjusts a gear inside the robot's open back panel; the robot calmly stamps the same page with a small stamp

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Turns out it was the checker.
